name: WCB Configurator Builder – Product Configurators Made Simple
author: Dons Digital

sections.description:
POWERFUL PRODUCT CONFIGURATOR PLUGIN FOR WOOCOMMERCE AND WORDPRESS

WCB Configurator Builder is the ultimate product configurator builder plugin for WordPress and WooCommerce. It helps you create powerfull product configurators in WordPress and WooCommerce without having to touch any line of code.

Moreover, the configurator builder comes with built-in support for stackable image layers to visualize the product image preview updates in real-time.
Plus, if you get the pro bundle, you can create stunning 3D product configurators right from your beloved WordPress admin dashboard.

The plugin does not require any coding knowledge to set up. Simply create your choices, design your form and upload your product images. However, if you do have coding knowledge, you can use our hooks and filters to customize the configuration templates to your likings.

You can use this product configurator builder to just highlight your product configuration options in WordPress, or take the next step and combine the configurator with request a quote or add to cart functionalities using WooCommerce.

Quick links:
– See the plugin in action
– Learn more about WCB (PRO)
– Browse add-ons
– Read the documentation

Confused about how to get started? Watch our get started video:

PLACES WHERE WCB CONFIGURATOR BUILDER HAS BEEN FEATURED

🏆 WCB Configurator Builder featured on WP Hive

🏆 WCB Configurator Builder featured on WP Mayor

🏆 WCB Configurator Builder featured on WP Daily Themes

MULTIPLE USE CASES

The WCB Configurator builder is a multi functional product configurator plugin that can be used for various use cases, including but not limited to:

  1. Extra product options and WooCommerce product add-ons
  2. Visual product configurators
  3. 3D product configurators
  4. Request quotes for custom products
  5. Guided selling forms
  6. Composite products
  7. WooCommerce product bundles
  8. Product customizations
  9. Measurement and cost calculators

Example products:
– Custom furniture and interior design
– Electronics (phones, wearables, etc)
– Computers and gaming
– Printed apparel and custom clothing
– Shoes and bags
– Music instruments
– Vehicles and parts
– Custom sheds and modular homes
– Tools and equipment
– Handmade items
– Accessoires
– Digital product customization

Any product with complex options is suitable for the WCB Configurator Builder. Flexible and responsive template design, drag and drop builder, real-time updates and block theme integration makes this plugin suitable for any custom product.

✨ FREE PLUGIN FEATURES ✨

DRAG AND DROP PRODUCT CONFIGURATOR BUILDER
Create and manage configuration fields with a drag-and-drop editor:
– Add unlimited fields
– Drag and hold to reorder fields
– Apply each configurator to any WooCommerce product or display on any page

REAL-TIME PRODUCT PREVIEW UPDATES
Automatically update your product visuals:
– Preview image changes
– Dynamic main image replacement
– Multi image product views supported
– Apply custom text styles

STACKABLE IMAGE LAYERS
Combine multiple images (layers) into a single live preview:
– Ideal for furniture, apparel, vehicle parts, and custom sets
– Layer-by-layer visibility control
– Support for transparent PNGs (and SVGs)

3D CONFIGURATOR: CUSTOMIZE PRODUCTS IN 360 DEGREE VIEW
Create stunning 360 degree configuration experiences:
– Based on 3D GLB models
– Show and hide specific parts
– Update textures and colors
– Add custom text and images
– Update 3D model background scenes
– Play or loop 3D animations
– AR support (on compatible devices)

VISUAL DRAG AND EDIT CONTROLS
Customers can easily drag, rotate and resize elements on the product image:
– Drag custom text and images in the product image
– Resize and scale text and image uploads
– Rotate image uploads and texts

FLEXIBLE CUSTOM PRODUCT FIELDS
Create unlimited option fields:
– Color swatches
– Image swatches
– Button groups
– Tab fields
– Text fields
– Number fields
– Radio buttons

REQUEST QUOTES SUPPORT
Allow customers to request quotes via forms or email:
– Send configurations via email
– Request quotes via forms

DYNAMIC PRICING RULES
Supports:
– Live price recalculation
– Per-option pricing
– Fixed price increases
– Sale prices
– Unit prices (charge per character or per numeric value)

BUILT-IN WOOCOMMERCE INTEGRATION
Sends all configuration data to:
– Add configurations to cart
– Checkout
– Order confirmation
– Multi currency support

MODERN THEME AND PAGE BUILDER SUPPORT
Insert configurators anywhere using:
– Gutenberg block
– Shortcode block
– Pre-built templates

CREATE UNLIMITED CONFIGURATIONS
Use on:
– Any number of products
– Any product type
– Any store size

CUSTOM CSS AND DESIGN SETTINGS
Style the configurator visually:
– Buttons, borders, spacing
– Step indicators
– Form elements
– Global styling

DEVELOPER-FRIENDLY
Includes:
– Hooks
– Filters
– Template override support

MULTI-LANGUAGE AND RTL-DISPLAY SUPPORT
The plugin is fully compatible with multi language plugins:
– WPML
– Polylang
– LocoTranslate

Read more about multi language

⭐️ PRO FEATURES ⭐️

Upgrade to WCB Configurator Builder Pro bundle for more advanced customization capabilities.

UNLOCK ADVANCED FIELDS
Extend your configuration form with advanced fields:
– Image dropdown
– Date picker field
– Color picker field
– Range slider field
– File upload field
– Field sliders
– Repeater field
– Panel options field

APPLY CONDITIONAL LOGIC
Take customization further with conditional display:
– Multi-condition rules
– AND/OR logic rules support
– Disable single options
– Show or hide fields

BUILD MULTI-STEP CONFIGURATION FORMS
Convert the configurator into a guided multi step wizard:
– Mandatory steps
– Next/Previous navigation
– Configuration summary page

SAVE AND RESUME CONFIGURATIONS
Allow customers to:
– Save their progress and resume later
– Add configurations to a wishlist
– Load saved designs

SET ADVANCED PRICING RULES
Pro-level pricing flexibility:
– Percentage based pricing
– Formula pricing
– Tiered table prices

PDF DOWNLOADS
Customers can easily download a PDF file containing:
– Configuration price
– Company details
– Selected options
– Generated images

CUSTOMER WISHLIST
Customers can easily save their favorite designs to their wishlist
– Save configurations to wishlist
– Load designs from wishlist
– Set WooCommerce account-based wishlist

INVENTORY MANAGEMENT
Store owners can easily manage their configurations options:
– Option weight management
– Option SKU management
– Option stock management

LINKED WOOCOMMERCE PRODUCTS
Store owners can easily build composite or bundled products using the linked products field:
– Link WooCommerce products to configuration options
– Add products to cart separately
– Manage product details (like title, stock, sku and price) in WooCommerce

CONFIGURATION ANALYTICS
Store owners can easily see best performing configuration options:
– See conversion rates
– Explore most selected configuration options
– Collect emails for customer retargeting

VISUAL PRODUCT CUSTOMIZER

Build visual product configurators with our product configurator builder tool. Add image layers, customize text and upload images.

You can also allow your customers to drag and resize text and images on the product images using the visual control settings provided in our plugin.

3D PRODUCT CONFIGURATOR

Step up your visual game with GLB 3D models. Change colors, update model parts and even show the 3D model in your own room using AR capabilities.

Change the visual display to 3D model in WCB > Settings and start creating stunning 3D configurations inside the WCB configurator plugin.

WOOCOMMERCE PRODUCT CONFIGURATOR

If you are running a WooCommerce store, you can also use this plugin to extend your regular WooCommerce products and add extra product options, like input fields, swatches, and more.

This product configurator plugin integrates seemlessly with the WooCommerce plugin. Connect your configurations to WooCommerce products and build stunning product configurators and customizers with ease.

You can choose to extend simple products or variation products.

Use the WooCommerce checkout system to handle the online purchasing process.

REQUEST QUOTES AND CPQ CONFIGURATOR

Allow your customers to ask for specific pricings using the request a quote feature of our plugin.

Simply link your configurator to your favourite form plugin or use the email button action and start collecting leads.

Supported form plugins include:
– WP Forms
– Forminator
– Fluent Forms
– Formidable Forms
– Gravity Forms
– Ninja Forms
– Contact Form 7

Note: basically any form plugin is supported as long as it allows you to set custom classes for input fields.

WOOCOMMERCE COST CALCULATOR

Get the advanced calculations add-on and create advanced price calculations using formula’s and tiered table prices

This allows you to perform advanced calculations based on numeric inputs and allows you to create a measurements cost calculator for example.

WORDPRESS PRODUCT CONFIGURATOR

The WCB configurator builder plugin is designed as a standalone plugin. You can use the shortcode to display your product configurator on any page you like.

About

This plugin is developed and maintained by Dons Digital.
sections.installation:
1. Upload wcb-configurator-builder.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WCB in the dashboard
  4. Add your fields
  5. Create a new configurator
  6. Assign it to a WooCommerce product
  7. Upload your visuals and create new visuals group in WCB > Visuals
  8. Save and test it on the frontend
sections.faq:
Will this plugin work with my theme?

Yes, the plugin will work fine in all well-coded (block) themes

Does this plugin work with page builders like Elementor?

Yes, the plugin works fine in page builders too.

Does the plugin include real-time previews?

Yes. Live preview and real-time updates are fully included.

Can I add text and images to the product image?

Absolutely! You can personalize the product image with text and images using the text visual controls. For image uploads you need our Advanced fields add-on.

Can I create configurators for different products?

Yes, unlimited configurators can be created.

Do you have a limit on the options?

No, the plugin has no limit to the amount of options you can add.

Does the plugin slow down my site?

No. It’s optimized for speed and lightweight in design.

Why do my configuration options not appear on WooCommerce products?

Make sure your product is purchasable. This means the WooCommerce product has a regular price set. If you want to start at 0, simply put 0 in the regular price field.

Are configuration details sent to the order?

Yes. All selected options appear in the cart, checkout, and order details.

Can I use this plugin without WooCommerce?

Yes! This plugin can be used in WordPress-based websites. You don’t need WooCommerce to build a product configuration.

What’s included in the Pro version?

Advanced features such as save and continue, conditional logic, tiered pricing, and more (see Pro Features section above).

Is support available?

Free users have community support; Pro users receive priority support.

Where can I find documentation?

You can find extensive documentation of our plugin on https://wpconfiguratorbuilder.com/docs/
